title: S4: Python symbols and scopes (ADR 0008)
description: ADR 0008 / DEC-303 (a2) rulings 2, 7: definitions, classes, methods, nested defs, qualified names, scopes, decorators, properties, overload groups, branch-conditional definitions. Emits SymbolEntry-shaped symbols plus the additive optional qualname (DEC-303 (a5) Q6 arm A: the full enclosing dotted name without the PEP 3155 <locals> segment); container keeps its documented meaning (nearest enclosing class). Built on the S2b parse wrapper; not wired to the CLI.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Rules per case written before the code and every case has a test
Every symbol of the click 7.1.2 and requests ground-truth targets exists at the keyed def/class line with the right qualname (scorer mapping, no exit 6)
qualname carries the full enclosing dotted name without a <locals> segment, e.g. Parameter.type_cast_value._convert; container is the nearest enclosing class only
Symbols in branches unreachable under Python 3 are still emitted (reachability is call attribution, not the symbol table)

implementationNotes: S4 BRIEF (approved by the leader; draft rule list the specialist refines in its first EMPTY commit): 1 identity (R, Addendum 2 rule 5): line = def/class keyword line, never a decorator line; startLine includes decorators and leading comments; id = file:line:column of the name as TypeScript; 2 qualname (R, Q6 arm A, DEC-303 (a5) commit 5b0781e4): emit an additive OPTIONAL qualname on symbols = the FULL enclosing qualified name (e.g. Parameter.type_cast_value._convert), absent for TypeScript; container keeps its documented meaning (nearest enclosing class); the gate scorer reads qualname and a target symbol without it is exit 6; 3 kinds (D): module-level def function, def in a class body method, property/.setter property, class class; staticmethod/classmethod are method; nested defs in functions are function; no new SymbolKind; 4 overload groups (R, Addendum 6 item 1): an @overload group collapses to its implementation: ONE symbol at the implementation line, stubs not emitted but counted in coverage; a group with no implementation keeps the last stub and notes it; the scorer maps stub-keyed ground-truth targets through test/python-gate/requests-3c7baaa/overload-groups.json; 5 branch-conditional definitions (R, (a3) Q2 plus the scorer exit-6 rule): every definition is emitted regardless of branch INCLUDING the if PY2 arm (symbols are not attribution; S5 owns reachability); two definitions with the same qualified name are both emitted at their own lines (e.g. click _compat.py get_text_stdin at 248 and 446); 6 decorators (D): each application is data for a later decorator site kind (S7 declares); a decorated name that returns another object is flagged not dropped (click @command); 7 class scope (D): class-body names are members; nested classes get the full path; global/nonlocal recorded as hints for S5; 8 lambdas and comprehensions (D): no symbol, scopes for S5; 9 module variables/assignments/__all__ (D): no symbol in S4; 10 exported (D): module-level def/class not starting with underscore, or listed in a literal __all__ when present; members of an exported class true; 11 async def same as def; 12 ERROR/MISSING (S2b inherit): a definition inside an ERROR region is dropped and the file named. ACCEPTANCE EVIDENCE: every ground-truth target of click (test/python-gate/click-7.1.2/targets.json, 45 targets) and requests (requests-3c7baaa/targets.json, 46) resolves through the scorer mapping (file + def line + qualname) without exit 6, using scratch checkouts of the pinned sources (not vendored; click 7.1.2 at 1784558e, requests at 3c7baaa; downloads from codeload into EMPTY scratch dirs, untrusted), the three overload stub targets mapped to their implementation lines. The branch needs the S0/S0b data: merge test/GCLI-74-requests-independent (data only; a conflict in a ground-truth/scorer/data file is a HARD STOP, docs conflicts are the workers). Dispatch only after the S2b delta review is clean (stack on feat/GCLI-73-python-parser 1eab226). No CLI wiring, no cache, no new dependency.

SUPERSEDING (2026-11-23, Opus S6 review): any earlier wording that container carries the whole enclosing qualified name is superseded by (a5) Q6 arm A. qualname = full enclosing dotted name WITHOUT the PEP 3155 <locals> segment (nested targets: Parameter.type_cast_value._convert, wrap_text._flush_par, should_bypass_proxies.get_proxy, _init.doc; an indexer emitting __qualname__ would exit 6 on them); container = nearest enclosing class.

S4 landed at 79fc3a2 (stacked on S2b 206324d plus the --no-ff merge of test/GCLI-74-requests-independent; push order S0/S0b before S3/S4). Verified by the worker under pinned bun 1.4.2: bun run check 322 pass 0 fail (289 before), lore 0.14.1 check 0/0; package.json and bun.lock untouched. Checker test/python-gate/check_symbol_targets.ts against pinned sources: click 133/133 targets (batch 0 45/45; targets.json holds 133 over batches 0-2, the brief's 45 is the scored batch 0), requests 46/46, 3 overload targets mapped to implementation lines; hard-fails on count mismatch, miss, duplicate signature, zero read. Mutations red: qualname->bare name, startLine->def line, collapseOverloadGroups disabled. STATED LIMITS for S7/S8: (1) the id column is tree-sitter's UTF-8 byte offset, TypeScript's is UTF-16: equal for ASCII, a named limit, no ground-truth target affected; (2) the checker is a TypeScript REPRODUCTION of the scorer's target mapping (gate_score.py _match_target_symbols/_target_symbol_line), not a run of gate_score.py: S4 has no call sites; the real end-to-end gate run is S8; (3) cached_property is a method (only property/.setter/.getter/.deleter are kind property); (4) rule 7 (class-body names are members) vs rule 9 (assignments are not symbols): class-body assignments emit no symbol; (5) a nameless def parses as ERROR in this grammar so rule 12's skipped-and-counted branch is unreachable through the public parser; (6) overload grouping is by qualname within one file, a group split across branches is not distinguished (no ground-truth case); (7) a group with several non-@overload definitions keeps all implementations; (8) decorator-replaces-object is not decidable statically: every decorated symbol is flagged, none dropped, S7 decides; (9) __all__: non-literal or += falls back to the underscore rule, a literal inside an if is not read. Rules R (ruled): def/class keyword line, qualname full dotted path without <locals> plus container nearest class, overload collapse, branch-conditional emission; all others D (proposals), listed in commit 73e5e4e.

CORRECTION (2026-11-23, measured by the worker at S3 287cc9a with parsePython on bytes containing a non-BMP character): the symbol id column is a UTF-16 code-unit offset in this binding, the same unit as TypeScript's, NOT a UTF-8 byte offset as the previous note (limit 1) and the README subsection state. parsePython decodes the bytes to a string before parsing, so node columns and startIndex are UTF-16 (x = '😀'; y: column 10 = UTF-16 index 10, UTF-8 offset 12). Limit 1 is withdrawn; the README and any comment in src/python/symbols.ts are corrected in the follow-up commit. Rule 1's id column D-rule stands: id = file:line:column of the name with the UTF-16 column.

# Opus review (claude-opus-5-5, 40 assistant records) of glyph-cli S4 (GCLI-76), local head 650ee6eb330b3cb501960e0e645f78e1d6ca2b48 (merge of origin/dev bd78650 into 442175a) — VERDICT: CHANGES REQUESTED (2 blocking, both with cheap fixes)

## BLOCKING
1. A definition can be lost to a parse error and the file is not named. src/python/symbols.ts:436-461 and 468-475; test/python-symbols.test.ts:1046-1052.
 - `errorFiles` is filled only when a recognised function_definition/class_definition node sits under an ERROR region. When tree-sitter's error recovery breaks a def into loose tokens inside ERROR, nothing is recorded: no `droppedDefinitions` entry, no `errorFiles` entry.
 - `buildPythonSymbols` then frees the tree and returns only the table. The parse's `hasError`, `errorCount` and `missingCount` are lost, so a caller of the convenience API (the checker is one) cannot tell the file had a parse error.
 - The change's own fixture is this case: `def :` parses as ERROR, and the test asserts only `symbols == []`. That is weaker than rule 12 ("dropped and the file named") and makes the silent path the expected result. Python 2 syntax in real repositories (print statements, `except X, e`) will reach it.
 - Fix: when `parse.hasError` is true, name the file (in `errorFiles` or a new `parseErrorFiles`), or carry `errorCount`/`missingCount` into the table. Make the nameless-def test assert it.
2. (reviewer's criterion 4) Recursion depth is unbounded by construction. src/python/symbols.ts:249-279 (`walk`) and 209-229 (`collectScopeHints.visit`).
 - Both recurse through `namedChildren` of every node, including whole expression subtrees. Depth is bounded only by expression nesting: a long left-deep `a + b + ...` chain or deeply nested literals in a generated file.
 - The sibling `parse.ts` `collectRegions` deliberately uses an explicit stack. No test pins a depth. The TypeScript indexer (`src/indexer.ts` forEachChild `visit`) is recursive too, so this may be judged non-blocking against that precedent (reviewer did not measure a crash threshold).
 - Fix: defs are statements, so stop descending into expression nodes (recurse only through module, block, compound-statement bodies, decorated_definition and ERROR), or use an explicit stack.

## NON-BLOCKING
3. Likely bug: `startLine` takes in a trailing comment from the previous line (symbols.ts:184-192). `leadingStartLine` accepts any comment sibling whose `endRow + 1 === startRow`. For `x = 1  # note` followed by `def f():`, f.startLine becomes the `x = 1` line. TypeScript's `spanStart` (src/indexer.ts:98, getLeadingCommentRanges) excludes same-line trailing comments. `touchedSymbols` (src/queries.ts:94) would over-attribute once wired; the gate is unaffected (keys on `line`). Fix: require the comment to start its own line, add a fixture.
4. The evidence was taken on a different object from the head under review: the task record's checker result (click 133/133, requests 46/46, 3 overload remaps) and `bun run check` (322 pass) were taken at 79fc3a2; 650ee6e also merges dev's squashed S2b (#120). PR CI re-runs `check`, but the checker needs scratch checkouts and never runs in CI. AC 1 is unproven at this head until the checker is re-run here and its output recorded.
5. Rule 12 coverage undercounts: lines 253-257 and 262-264: a def nested inside a dropped def is not walked, so droppedDefinitions understates the loss. Line 252: a decorated_definition with no `definition` field returns with no record. Lines 289-293: the `missing-name` branch is unreachable; a zero-width MISSING name identifier (`nameNode.isMissing`) is not checked and would emit `name: ""` (route it to `missing-name`).
6. Some test titles and README claims are stronger than their assertions: test:895 is titled "try/for/while" but has no `while`; no fixture defines a name in both a try arm and its except arm (the import-fallback pattern); the dotted `typing.overload` branch (`endsWith(".overload")`, line 155) is untested; nothing tests that `buildPythonSymbols` frees the tree (deleting `parse.tree.delete()` at line 473 fails no test; a parser-factory seam spy could pin it); the README's "`cached_property` is collected as a method" has no test; the purity test's `not.toBe` is an identity check and holds trivially.
7. The README's "Its stated limits:" lists 4 of the 9 limits in the task note. It omits the ERROR drop, overload grouping by qualname within a file, every decorated symbol being flagged rather than dropped, and the `__all__` fallback (also `__all__.extend(...)` is ignored and not stated). List all or point to GCLI-76. "not yet wired" is true.
8. Forward note for S8: `PythonSymbol`'s extra fields (`decorators`, `decorated`, `collapsedOverloadStubs`) will be written into the JSON envelope unless projected out; revisit `INDEX_FORMAT` (src/types.ts:10); `src/queries.ts:55` builds the display name as `container.name`, so a Python nested function would show as `Parameter._convert`; use `qualname` when wiring. Hygiene: the GCLI-76 record's status reads "To Do" while its notes say S4 landed.

## VERIFIED DIRECTLY (read only)
Checker matches gate_score.py `_match_target_symbols` and `_target_symbol_line` (same key format `file:line qualname`, on `line` = def/class keyword line and `qualname`; overload remap same keys as overload-groups.json with `_note` excluded; a target matching more than one symbol fails, the scorer's exit 6). The checker cannot pass on zero inputs (fails on a missing package directory, zero .py files, zero symbols, target count other than 133/46, batch-0 count other than 45/46, remap count mismatch, any miss, any duplicate); it checks all 133 click targets (stricter than the scorer's batch-0 seeds); it is a reproduction, not a run of the scorer; only package-relative paths exercised (repo-relative strip is S8's). qualname has the full dotted path with no `<locals>`; `container` is the nearest class name carried through nested functions (DEC-303 (a5) Q6 arm A, ADR 0002 amendment, TypeScript's container stack). Identity: `line` is the def/class node row (not a decorator), id/column are the name's row/column + 1; UTF-16 column pinned by the non-BMP test (15, UTF-8 would give 17). Branch-conditional definitions emit every arm; overload collapse never merges non-stub implementations; stubs carry their own qualname; class-body defs inside an `if` are still methods. Determinism: document-order walk, Map insertion order, stable sort in `applyExported`, sorted file list, no dependence on input file order. No try/catch in symbols.ts other than `finally`; the checker's single catch fails loudly. Type change `qualname?` is additive: TypeScript never sets it, JSON.stringify omits it, so TypeScript output, goldens, the cache and INDEX_FORMAT are unaffected; no schema in src/ lists SymbolEntry keys; ADR 0002 carries the amendment. Scope: 6 files, no package.json/bun.lock/.github change, no network or dependency use.
